description: Congratulations on starting your safety journey! This award recognizes your commitment to learning important safety skills.
Awarded to those who demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of safety protocols and procedures.
requirements: Complete 5 safety lessons and pass the knowledge test with 90% or higher

description: Recognizes mastery of water safety skills and the ability to help others stay safe around water.
requirements: Complete all water safety modules and demonstrate rescue techniques

description: For those who have mastered the art of marine navigation and can safely guide others.
requirements: Complete navigation training and successfully plan a multi-point route

description: Awarded to individuals who are prepared to handle emergency situations with confidence and skill.
requirements: Complete emergency response training and pass practical assessment

description: The highest achievement - recognizing complete mastery of all marine safety and navigation skills.
requirements: Unlock all other awards and mentor 3 new learners
